result.title: DuoPIC: Uncertainty-Aware Voxel-Level Digital Twins of Cerebral Perfusion with Transport PDEs in Acute Stroke
result.summary: Digital twins of cerebral perfusion relate tracer dynamics to cerebral blood flow (CBF), blood volume (CBV) and mean transit time (MTT), but must be data-driven, physically consistent and uncertainty-aware. We introduce DuoPIC, a digital twin that needs no reference maps, in which a Windkessel flow model drives a tracer transport partial differential equation (PDE). A population-level neural closure divides each region into fast and slow pathways with tracer mass and MTT conserved by construction, and a tempered posterior quantifies the uncertainty of every estimate. Its voxel maps set the state of the art for lesion detection on ISLES'17 MR (AUC 0.745) and ISLES'24 CT (0.743). On held-out patients, the neural PDE reduced the compartment's reconstruction error by 19% and lifted 95% MTT interval coverage from 88% to 94%. Code: https://github.com/detinatran/duopic

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 DuoPIC，用 Windkessel 血流模型驱动示踪剂输运 PDE，结合群体级神经闭合项与 tempered 后验，构建无需参考图的体素级脑灌注数字孪生，并在卒中数据集上评估病灶检测与不确定性覆盖。
AI.relevance_reason: 其体素级潜状态随 PDE 演化并用后验给出每个估计的不确定性，可能为 LVR 中空间隐状态的不确定性表达与基于置信度的停止决策提供概念参考，但领域相距较远，需核查其可迁移性。
